description: Official recorded peak water levels, Dec 2014 flood, used as the top anchor of the APPROXIMATE replay discharge→level curve (apps/api/src/hazards/water.ts). Levels in metres (JPS datum). Thresholds are as printed in the source table; our station thresholds (current JPS) differ for some gauges — see mappingNote.

source.title: JPS 'Laporan Catatan Aras Air Tertinggi' (1 Dec 2014 – 10 Feb 2015), reproduced in Prof. Ir. Mohd Nordin Adlan, 'Air' (CGSS, USM)

gauges.mappingNote: Only Dabong station (Sg. Galas di Dabong). Normal and danger match; our alert/warning are 35/37 (source 32/35) — current JPS thresholds differ from the 2014 table.

Only Tualang station (Sg. Lebir di Kg. Tualang). Normal and danger match; our alert/warning are 30/34 (source 27/31). Excluded from the hazards model (hazardGauge.usable = false: live level +20 m off the valley floor, i.e. mis-geocoded; see docs/HAZARDS.md), so this calibration has no effect until its location is fixed.
Sg. Kelantan di Kuala Krai; all four thresholds match.

NOT MAPPED: two candidates with identical thresholds 7/12/14/16 (source 10/12/14/16): 0731371WL 'Sg. Kelantan di Kusial' and gen-WL-cf8c18d849 'Sg. Kelantan di Kusial Baru'. Can't tell which is the Guillemard Bridge gauge; both are excluded from the hazards model anyway (hazardGauge.usable = false).
Sg. Kelantan di Tambatan D'Raja; all four thresholds match.
Sg. Golok di Rantau Panjang; all four thresholds match.
Sg. Golok di Kg. Jenob; all four thresholds match. Peak date is garbled in the source. Excluded from the hazards model (hazardGauge.usable = false), so no effect.

Only Pasir Puteh station (Sg. Semerak di Pasir Puteh). ALL thresholds differ: ours 2/2.5/3/3.2 (source 0.4/2/2.3/3). The 2014 peak (2.67 m) is below our danger level, so the curve drops the danger anchor for this gauge.
